question: Should this PR remain the landing path for Signal quote replies, including its public `replyToId: null` SDK contract, or should the work move behind the maintainer native Signal quote path?
rationale: The correct long-term API boundary and canonical Signal quote implementation require maintainer intent; automation can identify the conflict but cannot safely choose the public plugin contract.

options.title: Use the maintainer native quote path
options.body: Prefer the maintainer-sponsored Signal quote implementation as canonical, then port any unique tests or narrow fixes from this branch only if useful.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing branch only after fixing BodyForAgent quote context, removing or documenting the public null SDK contract, and adding live Signal proof.

options.title: Accept the public null contract
options.body: Bless `replyToId: null` as plugin API only with docs, API/baseline coverage, and explicit compatibility messaging.

recommendation.title: Use the maintainer native quote path
recommendation.body: Prefer the maintainer-sponsored Signal quote implementation as canonical, then port any unique tests or narrow fixes from this branch only if useful.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping maintainer-labeled native Signal quote PR carries the strongest current owner signal for this product/API decision.
